top_signals.title: Fed Governor Cook says she's 'prepared to act' on rate hike to address inflation
top_signals.summary: Cook was part of a 9-3 majority that voted last week to keep the central bank's benchmark borrowing rate in a range between 3.5%-3.75%.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Zillow’s Revenue Jumps as Rentals Offer ‘Bright Spot’
top_signals.summary: Zillow Group Inc. said Wednesday that second-quarter revenue jumped 18% from a year earlier to $772 million, as the online real estate company sees rental agreements growing more quickly than home purchases on its website and app.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
